svg.title: A cart on a spring at three positions
svg.desc: A cart attached to a horizontal spring on a level track, shown at x = −A with the spring compressed (spring force on the cart points right, toward equilibrium), at x = 0 (no spring force; the net force is zero while the cart moves through), and at x = +A with the spring stretched (spring force points left, toward equilibrium). The force is proportional to the displacement and opposite to it.
svg.text: The spring force always points back toward equilibrium
Fs, spring on cart: largest, to the right
Fs = 0: net force zero, cart still moving
Fs, spring on cart: largest, to the left
